resources.name: Login with email and password
resources.description: Authenticates a user and returns access and refresh tokens

resources.name: Login for admin panel (admin and superadmin only)
resources.description: Authenticates admin users and verifies they have ADMIN or SUPERADMIN role

resources.name: Logout and invalidate tokens
resources.description: Invalidates the current access token and optionally the refresh token by adding them to the blacklist

resources.name: Refresh access token
resources.description: Generates a new access token using a valid refresh token
